preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s) and all(c in 'ab' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in s) and any(c == 'b' for c in s) or any(c == 'a' for c in t) and any(c == 'b' for c in t)
preconditions.description: At least one of the strings must contain both 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output must start with a non-negative integer n representing the number of operations, and n must be within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= len(s) and 0 <= bi <= len(t) for ai, bi in swaps)

postconditions.expression: (all(c == 'a' for c in s) and all(c == 'b' for c in t)) or (all(c == 'b' for c in s) and all(c == 'a' for c in t))
postconditions.description: After performing the swaps, one string must consist entirely of 'a's and the other entirely of 'b's.
